entries.author: NICEPHORUS CALLISTUS XANTHOPULUS
entries.title: Ecclesiasticae Historiae libri VIII-XIV
entries.note: Elenchus prints the title then an unreadable column ('co].'). Body: Greek title block (NIKHPHOROY KALLISTOY XANTHOPOULOU EKKLESIASTIKES ISTORIAS TOMOS H) and Latin 'TOMUS VIII' with Cap. I at OCR lines ~191-300, on the first text page, before the first numbered page header (11|12 at line 364); the OCR carries no page numbers for the first pages, so bodyCol 9 is inferred, not read. Ordo prints Cap. I of Liber VIII with no column and Cap. II at 11, consistent with a first text page at 9|10 but not proof. The volume holds books VIII-XIV (Greek and Latin side by side), each with its own title block (Tomus IX line 15735, X 30930, XI 41729, XII 53961, XIII 66727, XIV 76689); the part columns come from the Ordo only.
